defaults.setup: Inspect the exact-version authored corpus, generated material, archive candidate, release manifest, and indexed evidence as applicable.
defaults.action: Run the corpus integrity, reproducibility, authority-layer, manifest, link, and release-gate checks against exact bytes.

rows.oracle: Every Markdown artifact labels one of the four layers and its exact full version with no ambiguous authority.
Authority scan finds every normative semantic only in authored contracts and no implementation/test/guidance claim as normative.
All stable requirement IDs are unique, fully traced, and delegate shapes/enumerations to the correct machine authority.
The index has exactly 13 settled groups and every effective row has setup, action, oracle/type, applicability, gate, and evidence.
Frozen outputs compare with reviewed literal bytes; structural, effect, independent-agent-review, and human release rows occur only at their settled observable seams.
Dispatcher rows run from the packaged core on real projects and internal controls are limited to deterministic publication faults.
Process/guided/release rows operate on actual installed or once-built candidate bytes at their named seams.
All corpus assets report exact lockstep version and every reference resolves offline without branch, discovery, source, or network dependency.
Contracts archives contain every required role/license item and each manifest path/media/role/hash matches exact bytes.
Regeneration from named authority digests reproduces CLI/MCP/package/support/llms reference byte-for-byte.
Guidance order and disclosures match the requirement, keeps specs one click away, and presents MCP only after CLI baseline.
Every inventory/channel/support claim derives from the exact manifest and passing immutable evidence; llms files remain indexes.
Stable gate fails for any incomplete applicable row; prerelease metadata carries no false conformance or host claim.
